?

Psalm 23:5 KJV
…thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
?
Anytime God decides to bless or give, He does it leaving the beneficiary dazed. To an onlooker, it’s like, “why this waste…isn’t the cup full?”

?Note, when God gives or blesses to an overflow, it is for the beneficiary to have enough and plenty left over to bless others
?
2 Corinthians 9:8 NLT puts it succinctly ?
And God will generously provide all you need. Then you will always have everything you need and plenty left over to share with others.
?
Today, you will be the beneficiary of Gods overflowing blessings in Jesus name
